messages:
priya_csm: Heads-up — NimbusFold dropped ~65% API calls over the last 48h and procurement just pinged with an RFQ. Champion (CTO) moved teams last week. Could use a quick triage + playbook decision.
ops-bot: alert: account=nimbusfold, usage_change=-65%, anomaly_score=0.87, recent_activity=drop at 2026-03-21T14:12Z
alex_cs_lead: Yikes. Any sign it's an integration bug vs deliberate pause? Is there a competing pilot?
mateo_ae: Procurement mentioned a shortlist with VendorX doing a focused pilot. I asked for dates; they said pilot started this Monday.
priya_csm: No recent support tickets beyond a few 429s Wed midday. I pinged the champion but haven't heard back. Recommend: (1) quick infra check, (2) proactive exec outreach, (3) offer a 2‑week dedicated trial to match pilot — thoughts?
jin_sre: Checked infra logs for their org_id. No errors 5xx. Saw elevated 429 spikes around 13:58 UTC on Wed. Could be rate-limited from their side or client-side retry loop.
kara_support: sharing snippet of the 429 lines we saw: ```2026-03-21T13:58:04Z nimbusfold req_id=abc123 status=429 tokens=34 route=/v1/generate``` ```2026-03-21T13:58:05Z nimbusfold req_id=abc124 status=429 tokens=128 route=/v1/embeddings``` Looks like a short burst, then user traffic drops off. No auth failures.
mateo_ae: I'll reach out to the procurement lead for specifics on VendorX pilot and ask for the decision timeline. If it's a feature/throughput concern, we can offer to provision a small dedicated pool for the pilot window.
priya_csm: Good. Alex — can you take the exec touch? A short call with the CTO or CPO to surface risks and confirm whether they paused usage intentionally?
alex_cs_lead: On it. I'll ask for a 20-min slot tomorrow. Also looping in legal to see if RFQ terms require any changes for a dedicated trial.
priya_csm: Meanwhile I'll prepare a one-pager: cost delta hosted vs 2-week dedicated, plus quick win enablement doc for the champion. Sharing draft in #customer-success-docs in 30m.
mateo_ae: If we offer credits or a pref test, call it out in the procurement thread — might keep them from signing up VendorX.
jin_sre: No infra blockers from our side. If we spin a dedicated mini-pool, we can have it live in ~6 hours once billing sign-off's done.
kara_support: I'll stand by for any logs/metrics the customer sends. Priya — ping me if they share a client-side stack trace.
priya_csm: Thanks team. Next steps: Mateo -> procurement intel, Alex -> exec call, Priya -> one-pager + champion outreach, Jin -> ready for provisioning if needed. Will update thread after the exec call. :triage: 
alex_cs_lead: Scheduling done — 20 min slot at 2026-03-22T16:00Z. Invites sent to NimbusFold CTO, CPO, Mateo, Priya, and me.
priya_csm: Logged. If call confirms competitive pilot, we'll present dedicated trial + enablement playbook. If it's just a usage bug, support will triage with customer.
mateo_ae: Procurement replied: RFQ response due end of month, pilot evaluation window through Apr 5.
priya_csm: Perfect — timeline gives us a narrow runway. Tagging this as high priority for the renewal cadence.
alex_cs_lead: Closing the loop after call. Good work team. :thumbsup:
